optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Rollout Project Manager, Warehouse Robotics Deployment

professionalSummary.text: Has taken customer sites live on the robotics system and run the cut-over from manual picking.
professionalSummary.witness: Took nine customer warehouses live on the goods-to-person robotics system between 2021 and 2025, running the cut-over from manual picking at each site over a weekend and the first live picking shift on the Monday morning.

experienceHighlights.text: Runs the hypercare fortnight after each go-live and handles stoppages raised by the customer's shift leaders.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the hypercare fortnight at all nine sites with the customer's shift leaders and handled the stoppages raised during hypercare; the stoppage log for each site records the cause, the fix and who cleared it.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Coordinates the installation schedule with field engineering before go-live.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Coordinated the installation schedule with field engineering for each site in the six weeks before go-live, holding the weekly installation review with the field lead.

skills.text: Runs the pre-go-live acceptance tests with the customer on the installed system.
skills.witness: Ran the pre-go-live acceptance tests with the customer on the installed system at each site, with the acceptance record signed by the customer's operations manager before cut-over.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish that the candidate has taken customer sites live on the robotics system, run the cut-over from manual picking, ran the hypercare fortnight, coordinated the installation schedule, and written the site closure report. The materials do not establish the specific site numbers or the stoppage logs.

decisionBoundary.statement: The materials establish that the candidate has the required experience and skills for the role. However, the specific site numbers and stoppage logs are not provided, and further verification is needed.
